# Open design findings that touch M0

The architecture set's coherence pass ended (owner ruling J153) with 62 findings open. These 12 touch what M0 builds — the kernel (§3), determinism (§6), the records the kernel and the digest need (§2), and the tests, packages, plan and clean room (§13, §14, §16, §17). The M0 build spec decides each one: resolved in the spec (the decision and its reason, under the owner's delegation), or not affecting M0. Design text only; 0 further M0 finding(s) citing the research side of §17.1's firewall are held back and resolved by a design seat.

| VCS-r6-05 | minor | scope | VAP-r5-05's new row type (§13.2, base l. 18369–18374) adds `kind: 'derived'` and `derivedFrom?: { file; mutation }`. This is test-kit only. | §13.2's `DossierFixtureRow`, two comment changes.
